'''Spray sticks''', also known as '''stokhli spray sticks''' or simply '''stokhli sticks''', were nonlethal ranged weapons used to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] and capture living beings. They were developed by the [[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] nomads of the planet [[Manress/Legends|Manress]].

==Description==
[[File:Stokhli_egwt.png|thumb|left|180px|Stokhli [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
Originally created by the nomadic [[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] species on the planet Manress, the sticks operated by shooting a spraynet; a fine spray-like mist of semisolid tendrils of thin translucent material. On contact, the tendrils hardened, and wraps around the target, immobilizing the creature or person, and delivered a powerful shocking charge.<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology"/> Extremely versatile, the spraystick was able to project a mist to an optimum range of 100 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and a maximum range of 200 meters. A thumb trigger adjusted the range finder to set how quickly the net formed, a dial set the width of the net, and a control button could alter the intensity of the stun range. Often used by big-game hunters, the strength of the net combined with the powerful electrical stun were powerful enough to take down a [[Gundark]], and were often used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to capture targets alive.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /><ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology"/>

Resembling a meter-long metal tube with a nozzle at one end, the sticks were usually fitted with stun pads to deliver additional shocks if the subject remained conscious. This allowed the weapon to be used as a close-range [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] as well.<ref name="Far Horizons" /> When fired, the weapon emitted a hissing sound, and the net sprayer caused significant recoil. The spraymist solution was resistant to most solvents, and it even exhibited considerable resistance to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] since it continuously re-formed until hitting its target.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /> For all its advantages, however, the weapon was less effective against [[Yuuzhan Vong]], as they were immune to the spray stick's shock charges.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Each stick weighted only four [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and held ten spraymist cartridges, with each cartridge producing 500 meters of netting.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" /> However, despite their effectiveness, they were rarely found off Manress since the spraymist solution was manufactured only by the Stokhli people, and the cost was considerably high at 14,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per weapon. Despite this, most galactic governments (including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]) were able to procure these [[Wikipedia:Less-lethal|less-than-lethal]] weapons.

==History==
Users of the Stokhli spray stick included [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] like [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] (who took his from a Stokhli nomad he encountered on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]), and some security organizations like [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] which used them to apprehend criminals.

[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] provided Stokhli spray sticks, nicknamed "goo guns," to the [[Professional Podracing Circuit|professional]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] and his henchmen (the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]], together with the hulking [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Khiss (Dug)|Khiss]], a Dug, and [[Gondry]], an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin cyclops]]), preparatory to their [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends#Gardulla's revenge|pursuit of unknown juvenile thieves]]: [[Anakin Skywalker]], his rescuer-friends, and the beautifully fragile creatures they rescued, the [[Ghostling]] children. The chase ran its course through the Hutt's notoriously dangerous [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] within [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|her Tatooine palace]]. The garden was filled with all manner of exotic (and mostly [[predator]]y) flora and fauna—in truth, it was a savage jungle. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] boy [[Dorn (Bothan)|Dorn]] was grazed by the stun-fire of a spray stick shot by the Sakiyan slave tracker, while Khiss the mercenary spray-stick blasted a huge [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slug]] back into the waters whence it surfaced to devour him. A hapless [[Worrt/Legends|worrt]] was next blasted by the Sakiyan and set to snoring.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperial security agents occasionally used Stokhli stun sprays to capture criminals and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents.

[[File:NoghriDeathCommandos-DRF3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Noghri Death Commandos with spray stick]]
During the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Noghri Death Commando]]s under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] used Stokhli spray sticks in a kidnapping attempt against [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] on the planet [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]. However, the Noghri attack failed.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

[[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] once used a Stokhli spray stick to create a bridge to reach an outside window on the twentieth floor of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Glovstoak]]'s palace. The spray mist solidified enough for her to climb, and eventually evaporated to leave no trace of her private pathway.

When the New Republic became the dominant galactic government, security officers used them to guard high-security prisoners. By [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a short-range version of the Stokhli spray stick was available which was almost small enough to be concealed. However, the Yuuzhan Vong were found to be immune to the stunning power of either type of Stokhli spray stick.
